title: LinkedIn Job Market Trend Input
description: Define the job market segments to track. Each keyword and location pair becomes one trend row, with a change figure when run on a schedule.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Role or skill terms to track. Each keyword is crossed with each location. Examples: 'data engineer', 'registered nurse', 'product manager'.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations to track. Leave empty for worldwide. Examples: 'United States', 'Germany', 'Remote', 'London'.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Optional LinkedIn experience filter applied to every query.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Optional employment type filter applied to every query.

remoteFilter.title: Remote type
remoteFilter.description: Optional on-site, remote, or hybrid filter applied to every query.

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: Optional recency filter. Tracking a 24 hour window run daily gives a clean new-postings velocity.

includeBreakdown.title: Include seniority and function breakdown
includeBreakdown.description: Parse the sample of role cards LinkedIn renders to add a seniority and function split per query. Adds no extra request.

trackDeltas.title: Track change since last run
trackDeltas.description: Store each query's count between runs so a scheduled run reports the change versus the previous run. The trend is the whole point.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. The public jobs search page is light; residential improves reliability at volume.
